name: Print a Document
description: Help the user print a document (letter, photo, recipe, etc.) using their printer
prompt:
The user wants to print something. FIRST ask what they want to print (a letter, photo, recipe, web page, etc.) — keeps the goal visible. Then check if their printer is on and has paper, since most print failures come from the printer side, not the computer side.

VISUAL GUIDE — PRINTING (universal flow, works on Windows and Mac with one keystroke difference): build a 6-step paginated guide using the illustrated assets:

  Step 1 (animated overview): image_id `print-document-demo`. Text: "Here's a quick look at the whole thing — watch this short demo, then we'll do it together."
  Step 2: image_id `print-document-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open the document you want to print on your screen."
  Step 3: image_id `print-document-illustrated-step-2`. Text on Windows: "Hold the Ctrl key on your keyboard and press P at the same time." Text on Mac: "Hold the Command key on your keyboard and press P at the same time."
  Step 4: image_id `print-document-illustrated-step-3`. Text: "A print window will pop up showing what your document looks like."
  Step 5: image_id `print-document-illustrated-step-4`. Text: "Check that the right printer is selected and the page count looks right."
  Step 6 (celebration): image_id `print-document-illustrated-step-5`. Text: "Click the blue Print button — your document will start printing 🎉"

If the printer doesn't show up at step 5, the printer is probably off or not connected — guide them to check the power and the cable/Wi-Fi. Reassure them this is the most common reason printing seems broken.
